opportunities.name: Hotel proposal: search Booking, convert price on Xe, email draft
opportunities.description: Search a hotel for a destination and dates on Booking.com, convert its price from EUR to a target currency on Xe, and compose an email proposing the hotel to a contact.
steps: On Booking enter destination and check-in/check-out dates, then Search
Open the first/chosen hotel result and note name and price
On Xe Currency Converter set the amount to the hotel price in EUR and choose the target currency
Click Convert and note the converted amount
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject 'Hotel for <city>, <dates>', and body with hotel, EUR price and converted price

instances.values: Frankfurt Nov 17-20, Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South, 818 EUR to USD, maria@example.com
Milan Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR to JPY, kenji@example.com
Amsterdam Jan 12-15 2027, Jan Luyken Amsterdam, 577 EUR to GBP, aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather + news heads-up email
opportunities.description: Look up a city's 10-day weather forecast, search BBC for a strike news story about the city, and email a contact a heads-up with the forecast and headline.
steps: On the weather site search for the city and open its 10 Day forecast
Note the high/low and conditions for the target day
On BBC search '<city> strike' and open the top relevant article, noting headline and date
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>', and body with forecast and headline

opportunities.name: Visa requirements + destination holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up a Wikipedia visa requirements page for a nationality, find the destination's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens' and find the destination entry
On timeanddate open Holidays and search/select the destination country
Read holidays for the relevant month
Add a new note summarizing visa status, allowed stay and holidays
